properties.description:
DELIVERED 2026-08-19, `epoch:the-loop-holds-the-invitation`. **This is the DELIVERY; `req:detecting-is-not-asking` states what is owed.**

A timing rule added to all THREE served surfaces that instructed the post-capture push, because each was individually correct and only their combination was the defect:
1. **served `AGENTS.md` step 2** — the canonical loop statement.
2. **`capture-intent` step 7** — where the post-capture push originates.
3. **`detect-and-ask`** — where the asking actually happens; its own trigger is *"after capturing new intent"*, so fixing the other two while leaving this one would let an agent reading this skill alone still interrupt.

Each carries Alex's report inline as its reason — including *"three gaps, not three hundred; the volume was never the problem"* — so a later session cannot revert it as fussiness without meeting the evidence. Each also states the counterweight in its own words: **this defers the INVITATION, never the RECORD.** Written three times deliberately, because the failure mode of a "be quieter" rule is that someone implements it as silence.

Also registers `art:detect-and-ask-skill`, which **had never existed** — the second such hole found this week, after `art:where-am-i-skill`.

🛑 **STATUS IS `realized`, NOT `verified`, AND THE GAP IS THE SAME ONE AS EVERY OTHER SERVED-PROSE FIX.** `skill_lint` proves the text is present in all three surfaces and byte-identical across the mirrors. **It cannot prove an agent honoured it.** That is precisely the shape of the instruction which lapsed within four days in `dec:idea-the-enum-question-came-back-four-days-after-it-was-fixed`, and it is stated here rather than discovered later.

⚠️ AND ONE JUDGEMENT REMAINS THE AGENT'S: *"plainly still pouring things in"* is not computable from the graph — the signals are conversational and live where reflow2 cannot see them. The explicit boundaries (they type the skill, ask what is open, or turn to building) are named in the text so the rule can never be read as "never ask".
properties.name: The loop detects on every capture and waits for a boundary before offering to close
